MG11.final:
Step1: Open the umbrella and line its inside with heavy-duty foil (shiny side up) to make a parabolic solar reflector.
Step2: Aim it at the sun and hold the food (on a foil-wrapped can/cup stand) at the focal point; use the binoculars' lens as an extra magnifier if needed. Cook with concentrated sunlight, no charcoal or bread needed.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG12.final:
Step1: Use the thin edge of the metal ruler (straightened by hand if needed) as a flat-head screwdriver in the screw slot.
Step2: Turn it clockwise to tighten the screw.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG13.final:
Step1: Use the metal file to roughen the metal around the hole, and the hairdryer to dry it.
Step2: Cut a patch from the rubber pool float (with the file edge), coat it with epoxy, wrap the cloth around it as a reinforcing layer, and press it over the hole from underneath.
Step3: Hold or wedge it in place (inflated float propped under it) and blow the hairdryer on the epoxy to speed up curing.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG14.final:
Step1: Wearing the gardening gloves, spread the large blanket on the snow.
Step2: Pile snow onto the blanket by hand, gather the corners and carry or drag it to the kiddie pool.
Step3: Tip the snow into the pool and repeat until full.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG15.final:
Step1: Lay the baking sheet over the center of the grill, and overlap sheets of aluminum foil around it to cover the remaining area.
Step2: Secure the foil edges to the baking sheet and grill with clothespins (optionally drape the tablecloth over a pole/tongs as extra shelter). The grill is covered and you can keep cooking.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG16.final:
Step1: Place the thick round pizza stone directly on top of the saucepan as the lid (it is round and heat-proof).
Step2: Use the wooden tenderizer or slotted spoon to lift/adjust it safely.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG17.final:
Step1: Wrap the fish in a towel from the beach bag, then put the bundle in the bag so the towel plugs the holes and holds the fish.
Step2: Carry the bag by its handles (the hat or swimsuit can add a second layer if needed).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG18.final:
Step1: Place the chair and stand the book stack on its seat for added height, and stand on it carefully.
Step2: Reach the microphone and adjust it by hand; alternatively tie the string around the rod's end into a loop to hook and pull it down.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG19.final:
Step1: At night, spread the sleeping mat on the ground (angled) to collect dew.
Step2: At dawn wipe the dew from the mat into the cup and drink; also lay the mat/notebook cover to catch dew on tree leaves.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG20.final:
Step1: Use the knife to whittle the toothpick into a thin wedge.
Step2: Push the wedge into the gap of the loose mirror joint to jam it tight and break off the excess; optionally wrap the duct tape around the joint for extra hold.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE
